metadata.source_version_discrepancy: Current HSE head-and-neck catalogue links to v2; NCIS October 2025 list names v3. This encoding follows the retrieved linked v2, and must be reconciled with NCCP before clinical use.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or the specialist authority specified in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Source-reconciled feasibility encoding of NCCP 00517 v2; no independent clinical or pharmacy approval.

indications.description: Treatment of locally advanced nasopharyngeal cancer.

treatment.schedule_summary: Gemcitabine 1,250 mg/m² on Days 1 and 8, with cisplatin 80 mg/m² on Day 1, every 21 days for 4–6 cycles or until progression or unacceptable side effects.

eligibility: Locally advanced nasopharyngeal cancer; the full treatment strategy is agreed by the multidisciplinary team.
exclusions: Relevant medicine hypersensitivity; check the current NCCP source and component-specific assessment rules.
Pre-existing CrCl <60 mL/min, peripheral neuropathy grade ≥2 or significant hearing impairment/tinnitus excludes cisplatin.
